name: Reishi Extract – 120 Capsules
description:
Reishi Extract – 120 Capsules Mushroom blend capsules | Shroom microdose capsules

Number of capsules: 120 cap

Capsule size: Size 0

Net Content Capsules: 400mg

Dosage: Take 1 capsule twice a day with water during the meal.

Reishi Extract – 120 Capsules powder;

.Reishi (Ganoderma Lucidum) also known as Japanese Lacquer Mushroom, can support the blood circulation and can support the body during stress. Studies also show that using Reishi greatly improves the sleep rhythm. Reishi also provides energy and resistance.

Ingredients per vegetarian capsule:

400 mg organic Reishi (Ganoderma Lucidum) extract of 100% fruiting body (mushroom). It is a full-spectrum extract obtained by means of H2O and ethanol. This is to get the most out of the fruiting bodies. It contains 30% polysaccharides and beta-glucans

Excipients: Magnesium Citrate and Silicon Dioxide.

Benefits of reishi mushroom extract Can provide assistance with:

– Support of health, heart and blood vessels because Reishi optimizes oxygen transport.

– Works against different types of inflammation and helps to prevent them.

– During busy periods, Reishi can provide support to deal with the additional stress.

– Reishi can contribute to a good night’s sleep, allowing the body to recover better.

– Taking Reishi regularly can balance hormones

Reishi Extract – 120 Capsules complex Warning:

Keep out of reach of children.

Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have health problems.

This is a dietary supplement and should be used as such.

japanese reishi mushroom extract, mushroom extract reishi, pure reishi mushroom extract, red reishi mushroom extract powder
